scope_note: Covers the vitamin content requirements for margarine sold by retail in Scotland, the instrument that imposes them, and the offence and enforcement provisions attached. Limited to Scotland and to legislation.

steps.title: Identify the current Scottish instrument
steps.detail: Find the instrument currently governing the composition of margarine sold by retail in Scotland and confirm it is the one in force rather than a predecessor.

steps.title: Retrieve the vitamin content requirement
steps.detail: Retrieve the regulation setting minimum and maximum vitamin A and vitamin D levels, with the exact figures and the unit they are expressed in.

steps.title: Retrieve the offence, enforcement and exemption provisions
steps.detail: Identify what contravention amounts to, who enforces, the penalty, and which products are exempt.
